description: tests/crdt_properties.rs documents the decision to use proptest for CRDT properties (commutativity, idempotency, convergence). The comment explicitly states that hand-crafted tests cannot explore the state space and that proptest has historically caught CRDT edge cases. The 1000-case commutativity test and 200-case convergence-after-partition test are appropriate coverage levels. The test comment forbidding replacement with example-based tests is correct and should be maintained.
title: DECISION: proptest for CRDT commutativity and convergence is mandatory and correct
